notes: Elections are run by the County and District Clerk (Mozelle Carr per search summary). A clerk site exists with an elections page (lovingcountyanddistrictclerk.com/elections-1, title 'loving county elections') and county pages at co.loving.tx.us/page/loving.County.Clerk, but no source shows whether election results are posted there, so results_url, host and platform are left empty/unknown. NO_SITE_OR_SOS_ONLY is not supported: no source states that results are available only through the SOS, and a county elections page exists. Results seen are third-party aggregations (Ballotpedia, RightDataUSA, Wikipedia) with no timing. Phone 432-309-9500 (Ext. 6) and emails Elections@lovingcounty.org / cclerk@co.loving.tx.us appeared only in a search summary, not attributed verbatim to a county or SOS page, so left empty. No 2025/2026 statement about precinct-level reporting found. Loving County has a single-digit number of precincts and about 100 registered voters, which does not by itself establish any reporting practice. No usage notice seen. Fetch module: 1 direct attempt on the clerk elections page plus wayback_probe (3 CDX windows) on lovingcountyanddistrictclerk.com/, all robots_disallowed_or_unreachable. WebFetch not attempted (all prior attempts EGRESS_BLOCKED).
tag_rationale: No county results site was confirmed and no source describes election-night or precinct-level posting; there is also no source establishing SOS-only reporting. Tag UNKNOWN.
